## Publish

::: {.om-cards}

::: {.om-card}
### AquaMaps EOV share: extinction-risk weighted habitat share by Essential Ocean Variable

Extinction-risk weighted habitat share of AquaMaps species by Essential Ocean Variable on the 0.05 degree global grid, published as COGs, H3 Parquet and a STAC collection.

- Notebook: [aquamaps_eov.html](aquamaps_eov.html)
- Target: `aquamaps_eov`, schedule `manual`
- Output: [https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/provenance.json](https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/provenance.json)
- Product (stac-collection): [STAC collection](https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/collection.json)
- Product (cog): [Risk-weighted share score (COG, 9 bands)](https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/score_risk.tif)
- Product (cog): [Share score (COG, 9 bands)](https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/score_share.tif)
- Product (parquet): [H3 resolution 5 scores and densities](https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/h3_r5.parquet)
- Product (parquet): [Taxon crosswalk by EOV](https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/atlas/aquamaps_eov/eov_taxa.parquet)
:::

:::
